summary.headline: Astrological Query Chapters 53–73
summary.text: Astrological query chapters 53–73 address duration, rulers’ mutual affection, succession, dreams, travel, disasters, sales, fame, earthquakes, requests, migration, winds, inheritance, names, absent persons, outcomes, birth data, and determining the 11th place from an astrolabe, with cross-references to codex 7.
